entry.title: Burrow 0.7.1
entry.summary: Burrow Hub: a folder explorer in the Import dialog (Home, Desktop, Documents and Downloads shortcuts, breadcrumbs, projects marked) and in the dialog that locates a moved project.

entry.title: Burrow 0.7.0
entry.summary: New gogame package: a trusted plain-Go game with OnStart, OnTick, OnFrame and UI.

entry.title: Burrow 0.6.1
entry.summary: runtime.tick_rate can be 20, 30, 40 or 60; journals record it and refuse a replay at another rate.

entry.title: Burrow 0.6.0
entry.summary: Everything in a scene is an entity, with shaders and materials, per-world voxel size and micro-voxels.

entry.title: Burrow 0.5.2
entry.summary: An editor and assets release: glTF import, full-screen tools for every asset and world editor, a real Play, and a redesigned look.

entry.title: Burrow 0.5.1
entry.summary: A small rendering fix for block textures.

entry.title: Burrow 0.5.0
entry.summary: A multiplayer release with voice chat, replicated servers, matchmaking, a lobby, a dedicated server, game UI widgets and better agent tooling.

entry.title: Burrow 0.4.2
entry.summary: Reworked model, texture, game UI and animation tools, fire on torches, and fixes for placement and mounted blocks.

entry.title: Burrow 0.4.1
entry.summary: Project-defined blocks and items, block logic for machine mods, scriptable and faster water, a redesigned website and a fix for double clicks.

entry.title: Burrow 0.4.0
entry.summary: An editor release: a real asset manager, a built-in code editor with VS Code hand-off, and every content creator one menu away.

entry.title: Burrow 0.3.2
entry.summary: Fine water fix: a stream running over a river bank no longer draws broken sheets.

entry.title: Burrow 0.3.1
entry.summary: Fine water by default, a game inventory, water particles and determinism fixes.

entry.title: Burrow 0.3.0
entry.summary: Buoyancy and swell for physics bodies, variable voxel size, a creative mode in the editor, a building guide for agents and multiplayer fixes.

entry.title: Burrow 0.2.3
entry.summary: runtime.blocks: "shapes" is now the default and the only supported block registry.

entry.title: Burrow 0.2.2
entry.summary: Sound, Hub and scripting fixes, plus a new Scripting documentation category. Upgrade recommended: the sound bug affects every game and the editor.

entry.title: Burrow 0.2.1
entry.summary: Performance and Windows fixes. Upgrade recommended on Windows.
